name: answering-side-announces-headers
description: The peer that did **not** open the stream sends its leading headers before it has produced anything at all, on a data frame with no payload, and then streams the body (WSM-FRM-016, WSM-API-024). Two things are pinned that only differ here: the headers frame carries no payload key, so a port that folded headers into the first chunk would fail the first expect_frame; and the opener's own stream surfaces them under `reply_headers` before the first row arrives, which is the whole point of announcing rather than trailing. `headers` and `reply_headers` are two attributes and each reads the same from either end, so all four readings are asserted: the open's on the acceptor, the answer's on the dialer that received them and on the acceptor that sent them.
